title: Bride and Groom Exiting Church, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from October 28, 1950, capturing a newlywed bride and groom leaving a church entrance. The bride wears a full-length tiered satin gown with long sleeves and an ornate headpiece, while the groom is clad in a dark tuxedo with a white boutonniere. Wedding guests and a child look on in the background.
